summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) reporting its third quarter 2026 financial results. The filing includes revenue, net income, EPS, and capital ratios, and notes a $269 million charge related to the announced sale of CIBC Caribbean Bank Limited. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situation event. The mention of the divestiture is incidental to the results and was previously announced. No new deal terms, structural mechanics, or advisor details are provided. The filing is a standard periodic report for a foreign private issuer.
